name: crip-inventory
description: CRIP domain agent: what exists in Azure and how well it is tagged, from Azure Resource Graph.
summary: What runs where, and how well it is tagged for cost ownership.

delegation_tool.name: ask_inventory
delegation_tool.description: Ask the Inventory agent WHAT RESOURCES EXIST in Azure: how many resources, of which types, in which regions and resource groups, and tag coverage/governance (what share of resources carry a given tag such as owner, costCenter or environment, and which resource groups are worst). Answers come from live Azure Resource Graph data.

examples: What resources do I have, and in which regions?
How many of my resources are missing an 'owner' tag?

tools.name: inventory_resource_summary
tools.description: Resource counts by type and by location for a subscription or resource group, and optionally tag coverage for one tag key per resource group.

tag_key.description: Optional tag name to measure coverage for, e.g. 'owner', 'costCenter', 'environment'.

top_n.description: How many types/locations/resource groups to itemise. Defaults to 10.
